senses.gloss: (cmp. פָּרַם, פָּרַס) to cut, divide; cmp. פָּסַק,] to assign.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:5">B. Mets. V, 5</cite> <he>ומַפְרִין על שדהו</he> Var. (v. <cite ref="Q01744"><he>פָּרַז</he></cite>) and may make an arrangement for his field; expl.

ib. 69ᵇ השוכר … ואומר תן לי מאתים זוז ואפרנסנה וכ׳ if one rents a field at a rent of ten Kor of wheat a year, and says, lend me two hundred Zuz and I shall improve the field, and I offer thee twelve Kor a year (v. פָּרָה Hif.).—Esp. to endow a bride, to promise a dowry.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 24:60">Gen. XXIV, 60</cite>) they were poor <he>ולא היו מַפְרִינִים אלא בפה</he> and endowed (the bride) only with their mouth (with a blessing); Yalk. ib. 109 <he>ולא היו מפרינין אותה וכ׳</he> (not <he>אותו</he>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:16">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> end <he>מפרינים</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130">Yalk. ib. 130</cite> <he>מפריכין</he> (corr. acc.; Ar. <he>מפריסים</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01908"><he>פָּרַס</he></cite>).
